import OAI.Algorithms.SubexponentialSAT.LeanCompat
import OAI.Algorithms.SubexponentialSAT.WeightedSupport
import OAI.Algorithms.SubexponentialSAT.NilpotentDefect

namespace OAI.Algorithms

/-!
# Canonical truncation before substitution

Polynomials are represented with U outermost, Z in the middle, and the X variables
innermost.  Truncation is an operation on canonical polynomial representatives;
we never assert that U = 1 defines a map out of the truncated quotient.
-/

namespace SubexponentialSAT.Truncation

noncomputable section

open scoped BigOperators

variable {R ι : Type*} [CommSemiring R]

abbrev Poly (ι R : Type*) [CommSemiring R] :=
  Polynomial (Polynomial (MvPolynomial ι R))

/-- Delete all coefficients of degree at least n. -/
def trunc {A : Type*} [Semiring A] (n : ℕ) (P : Polynomial A) : Polynomial A :=
  Polynomial.ofFinsupp (.ofCoeff (P.toFinsupp.coeff.filter fun j => j < n))

@[simp] theorem coeff_trunc {A : Type*} [Semiring A]
    (n j : ℕ) (P : Polynomial A) :
    (trunc n P).coeff j = if j < n then P.coeff j else 0 := by
  classical
  simp [trunc, Polynomial.coeff, Finsupp.filter_apply]

@[simp] theorem trunc_zero {A : Type*} [Semiring A] (n : ℕ) :
    trunc n (0 : Polynomial A) = 0 := by
  ext j
  simp

@[simp] theorem trunc_add {A : Type*} [Semiring A]
    (n : ℕ) (P Q : Polynomial A) :
    trunc n (P + Q) = trunc n P + trunc n Q := by
  ext j
  by_cases h : j < n <;> simp [h]

/-- Delete X monomials whose total degree exceeds N. -/
def xTrunc (N : ℕ) (P : MvPolynomial ι R) : MvPolynomial ι R :=
  .ofCoeff ((AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff P).filter
    fun a : ι →₀ ℕ => a.sum (fun _ k => k) ≤ N)

@[simp] theorem coeff_xTrunc (N : ℕ) (a : ι →₀ ℕ) (P : MvPolynomial ι R) :
    (xTrunc N P).coeff a =
      if a.sum (fun _ k => k) ≤ N then P.coeff a else 0 := by
  classical
  simp [xTrunc, Finsupp.filter_apply]

@[simp] theorem xTrunc_zero (N : ℕ) : xTrunc N (0 : MvPolynomial ι R) = 0 := by
  ext a
  simp

import OAI.Algorithms.SubexponentialSAT.LeanCompat
import OAI.Algorithms.SubexponentialSAT.Incidence
import OAI.Algorithms.SubexponentialSAT.Types

namespace OAI.Algorithms

/-!
# Incidence slots and globally consistent factor words

Section 5.4 assigns each coordinate's incident factors to different slots.
The same factor word is then used at every incidence of that factor.  The
slot numbers themselves need not agree at different coordinates.

The ordered constructor and the slot-filling operations are computable.  An
additional constructor for arbitrary finite factor types chooses an enumeration.
No running-time bound or probabilistic independence assertion is hidden here.
-/

namespace SubexponentialSAT.SlotAssignment

open SubexponentialSAT.Factor SubexponentialSAT.Types

variable {V E : Type*} [DecidableEq V]

/-- The actual factors incident to one coordinate. -/
abbrev Incident (P : Pattern V E) (v : V) := {e : E // v ∈ P.scope e}

/-- An injective slot assignment separately at each coordinate. -/
abbrev SlotMap (P : Pattern V E) (Δ : ℕ) :=
  (v : V) → Incident P v ↪ Fin Δ

@[simp] theorem card_incident [Fintype E] (P : Pattern V E) (v : V) :
    Fintype.card (Incident P v) =
      (Finset.univ.filter fun e => v ∈ P.scope e).card := by
  exact Fintype.card_subtype _

/-- The incidence bound supplies exactly the cardinal inequality needed for slots. -/
theorem card_incident_le [Fintype E] (P : Pattern V E) {k Δ : ℕ}
    (hP : P.Bounded k Δ) (v : V) : Fintype.card (Incident P v) ≤ Δ := by
  rw [card_incident]
  exact hP.incidence_le v

/-- A finite slot assignment, using a chosen enumeration for each incident set. -/
noncomputable def slotsOfCardLE [Fintype E] (P : Pattern V E) {Δ : ℕ}
    (h : ∀ v, Fintype.card (Incident P v) ≤ Δ) : SlotMap P Δ :=
  fun v => (Fintype.equivFin (Incident P v)).toEmbedding.trans (Fin.castLEEmb (h v))

/-- Slot assignments exist for every bounded factor pattern. -/
noncomputable def slotsOfBounded [Fintype E] (P : Pattern V E) {k Δ : ℕ}
    (hP : P.Bounded k Δ) : SlotMap P Δ :=
  slotsOfCardLE P (card_incident_le P hP)

/-- For ordered factor indices, sort the incident factors and use their ranks.
This constructor makes the fixed local ordering in the exposition explicit. -/
def orderedSlotsOfCardLE [Fintype E] [LinearOrder E] (P : Pattern V E) {Δ : ℕ}
    (h : ∀ v, Fintype.card (Incident P v) ≤ Δ) : SlotMap P Δ :=
  fun v => (Fintype.orderIsoFinOfCardEq (Incident P v) rfl).symm.toEquiv.toEmbedding.trans
    (Fin.castLEEmb (h v))

import OAI.Algorithms.SubexponentialSAT.LeanCompat
import OAI.Algorithms.SubexponentialSAT.Incidence
import OAI.Algorithms.SubexponentialSAT.Types

namespace OAI.Algorithms

/-!
# Incidence slots and globally consistent factor words

Section 5.4 assigns each coordinate's incident factors to different slots.
The same factor word is then used at every incidence of that factor.  The
slot numbers themselves need not agree at different coordinates.

The ordered constructor and the slot-filling operations are computable.  An
additional constructor for arbitrary finite factor types chooses an enumeration.
No running-time bound or probabilistic independence assertion is hidden here.
-/

namespace SubexponentialSAT.SlotAssignment

open SubexponentialSAT.Factor SubexponentialSAT.Types

variable {V E : Type*} [DecidableEq V]

/-- The actual factors incident to one coordinate. -/
abbrev Incident (P : Pattern V E) (v : V) := {e : E // v ∈ P.scope e}

/-- An injective slot assignment separately at each coordinate. -/
abbrev SlotMap (P : Pattern V E) (Δ : ℕ) :=
  (v : V) → Incident P v ↪ Fin Δ

@[simp] theorem card_incident [Fintype E] (P : Pattern V E) (v : V) :
    Fintype.card (Incident P v) =
      (Finset.univ.filter fun e => v ∈ P.scope e).card := by
  exact Fintype.card_subtype _

/-- The incidence bound supplies exactly the cardinal inequality needed for slots. -/
theorem card_incident_le [Fintype E] (P : Pattern V E) {k Δ : ℕ}
    (hP : P.Bounded k Δ) (v : V) : Fintype.card (Incident P v) ≤ Δ := by
  rw [card_incident]
  exact hP.incidence_le v

/-- A finite slot assignment, using a chosen enumeration for each incident set. -/
noncomputable def slotsOfCardLE [Fintype E] (P : Pattern V E) {Δ : ℕ}
    (h : ∀ v, Fintype.card (Incident P v) ≤ Δ) : SlotMap P Δ :=
  fun v => (Fintype.equivFin (Incident P v)).toEmbedding.trans (Fin.castLEEmb (h v))

/-- Slot assignments exist for every bounded factor pattern. -/
noncomputable def slotsOfBounded [Fintype E] (P : Pattern V E) {k Δ : ℕ}
    (hP : P.Bounded k Δ) : SlotMap P Δ :=
  slotsOfCardLE P (card_incident_le P hP)

/-- For ordered factor indices, sort the incident factors and use their ranks.
This constructor makes the fixed local ordering in the exposition explicit. -/
def orderedSlotsOfCardLE [Fintype E] [LinearOrder E] (P : Pattern V E) {Δ : ℕ}
    (h : ∀ v, Fintype.card (Incident P v) ≤ Δ) : SlotMap P Δ :=
  fun v => (Fintype.orderIsoFinOfCardEq (Incident P v) rfl).symm.toEquiv.toEmbedding.trans

SOURCES: src/kernels/cuda/fused_gdn.cu
Single-token fused gated-delta-net decode: causal-conv + SiLU + L2 norm, the alpha/beta projections, and the

## Source semantics

namespace Strata.FusedGdnDecode

-- § exact-arithmetic reduction library
/-- Sum of `f 0 .. f (n-1)` over the integers (exact model of a reduction). -/
def sumTo (f : Nat → Int) : Nat → Int
  | 0 => 0
  | n+1 => sumTo f n + f n

/-- Splitting a reduction at an arbitrary point. -/
theorem sumTo_add (f : Nat → Int) (n m : Nat) :
    sumTo f (n+m) = sumTo f n + sumTo (fun r => f (n+r)) m := by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp [sumTo]
  | succ m ih =>
    have e : sumTo f (n + (m+1)) = sumTo f (n+m) + f (n+m) := rfl
    have e2 : sumTo (fun r => f (n+r)) (m+1) = sumTo (fun r => f (n+r)) m + f (n+m) := rfl
    rw [e, ih, e2]
    omega

/-- A reduction over `a*b` items equals the reduction of `a` block reductions of `b` items. -/
theorem sum_blocks (f : Nat → Int) (b a : Nat) :
    sumTo f (a*b) = sumTo (fun r => sumTo (fun c => f (r*b+c)) b) a := by
  induction a with
  | zero => simp [sumTo]
  | succ a ih =>
    have h : (a+1)*b = a*b + b := Nat.succ_mul a b
    rw [h, sumTo_add f (a*b) b, ih]
    try rfl

/-- Scalar factors pull out of a reduction. -/
theorem sum_scale (g : Int) (f : Nat → Int) (n : Nat) :
    sumTo (fun i => g * f i) n = g * sumTo f n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [sumTo]
  | succ n ih => simp [sumTo, ih, Int.mul_add]

/-- Decaying the state before contracting with k equals decaying the contraction. -/
theorem decay_commutes (g : Int) (s k : Nat → Int) (n : Nat) :
    sumTo (fun i => g * s i * k i) n = g * sumTo (fun i => s i * k i) n := by
  have h : (fun i => g * s i * k i) = (fun i => g * (s i * k i)) :=
    funext fun i => Int.mul_assoc _ _ _
  rw [h, sum_scale]

/-- State size (rows = cols). -/

/-- Row groups per column. -/
def RG : Nat := 4
/-- Rows per group. -/
def RPG : Nat := S / RG

/-- 32 rows per thread. -/
theorem rpg_eq : RPG = 32 := by decide

/-- The row groups tile the state rows exactly. -/
theorem rg_mul_rpg : RG * RPG = S := by decide

/-- Block size is 512 threads. -/
theorem block_threads : S * RG = 512 := by decide

theorem tid_div (rg col : Nat) (h2 : col < S) : tid rg col / S = rg := by
  simp only [tid, S] at *
  omega

/-- The column is recovered from the flat id. -/
theorem tid_mod (rg col : Nat) (h2 : col < S) : tid rg col % S = col := by
  simp only [tid, S] at *
  omega

/-- Distinct (rg, col) give distinct flat ids. -/
theorem tid_inj (a b c d : Nat) (hb : b < S) (hd : d < S) (h : tid a b = tid c d) : a = c ∧ b = d := by
  simp only [tid, S] at *
  omega

-- § exact-arithmetic reduction library
/-- Sum of `f 0 .. f (n-1)` over the integers. -/
def sumTo (f : Nat → Int) : Nat → Int
  | 0 => 0
  | n+1 => sumTo f n + f n

/-- Additivity of reductions. -/
theorem sum_add_fn (f g : Nat → Int) (n : Nat) :
    sumTo (fun i => f i + g i) n = sumTo f n + sumTo g n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [sumTo]
  | succ n ih => simp only [sumTo, ih]; omega

/-- The zero function reduces to zero. -/
theorem sumTo_zero_fn (m : Nat) : sumTo (fun _ => (0 : Int)) m = 0 := by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp [sumTo]
  | succ m ih => simp [sumTo, ih]

/-- Double reductions commute (reduction order is irrelevant in exact arithmetic). -/
theorem sumTo_comm (g : Nat → Nat → Int) (m n : Nat) :
    sumTo (fun a => sumTo (g a) m) n = sumTo (fun b => sumTo (fun a => g a b) n) m := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [sumTo, sumTo_zero_fn]
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [sumTo]
    rw [sum_add_fn, ← ih]

/-- Splitting a reduction at an arbitrary point. -/
theorem sumTo_add (f : Nat → Int) (n m : Nat) :
    sumTo f (n+m) = sumTo f n + sumTo (fun r => f (n+r)) m := by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp [sumTo]
  | succ m ih =>
    have e : sumTo f (n + (m+1)) = sumTo f (n+m) + f (n+m) := rfl
    have e2 : sumTo (fun r => f (n+r)) (m+1) = sumTo (fun r => f (n+r)) m + f (n+m) := rfl
    rw [e, ih, e2]
    omega

/-- A reduction over `a*b` items equals the reduction of `a` block reductions of `b` items. -/
theorem sum_blocks (f : Nat → Int) (b a : Nat) :
    sumTo f (a*b) = sumTo (fun r => sumTo (fun c => f (r*b+c)) b) a := by
  induction a with
  | zero => simp [sumTo]
  | succ a ih =>
    have h : (a+1)*b = a*b + b := Nat.succ_mul a b
    rw [h, sumTo_add f (a*b) b, ih]
    try rfl

    sumTo (fun lane => sumTo (fun r => f (r * 32 + lane)) 4) 32 = sumTo f 128 := by
  have h1 : sumTo (fun lane => sumTo (fun r => f (r * 32 + lane)) 4) 32
      = sumTo (fun r => sumTo (fun lane => f (r * 32 + lane)) 32) 4 :=
    sumTo_comm (fun lane r => f (r * 32 + lane)) 4 32
  rw [h1]
  exact (sum_blocks f 32 4).symm

theorem col_owner (c : Nat) (hc : c < 128) :

  ⟨c / 4, c % 4, by omega, by omega, by omega⟩

/-- Column ownership is injective. -/

theorem block_size : 32 * 4 = 128 := by decide

/-- Byte-span overlap test used by the host wrapper. -/
def overlap (a an b bn : Nat) : Prop := a < b + bn ∧ b < a + an

/-- Overlap is symmetric. -/

  constructor <;> intro h <;> omega

/-- Adjacent spans never overlap. -/

  unfold overlap
  omega

/-- A span never overlaps one that ends where it begins. -/

  unfold overlap
  omega

/-- A nonempty span overlaps itself. -/

  unfold overlap
  omega

/-- State bytes are 128*128*h_v*4. -/

  have h2 := congrArg (fun x => x % B) h

  have h1 : a + 1 ≤ A := ha

theorem pair_mod (a b B : Nat) (hb : b < B) : (a * B + b) % B = b := by

  have h2 := congrArg (fun x => x % B) h

/-- Quantisation group size. -/

/-- Symmetric int8 clamp. -/
def clamp127 (q : Int) : Int := if q < -127 then -127 else if 127 < q then 127 else q

/-- The clamp always lands in [-127, 127] (never -128). -/
theorem clamp127_bounds (q : Int) : -127 ≤ clamp127 q ∧ clamp127 q ≤ 127 := by
  unfold clamp127
  split <;> try split
  all_goals omega

/-- The clamp is the identity on in-range values. -/

  unfold clamp127
  split <;> try split
  all_goals omega

/-- The clamp is idempotent. -/

  clamp127_id _ (clamp127_bounds q).1 (clamp127_bounds q).2

  obtain ⟨e3, e4⟩ := pair_inj page h page' h' kvh hkvh hh hh' e1
  exact ⟨e3, e4, e2⟩

namespace Strata.KvQ8Cache

-- § mixed-radix lemmas
/-- Row-major pair bound. -/
theorem pair_lt (a b A B : Nat) (ha : a < A) (hb : b < B) : a * B + b < A * B := by
  have h1 : a + 1 ≤ A := ha
  have h2 : (a + 1) * B ≤ A * B := Nat.mul_le_mul_right B h1
  rw [Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul] at h2
  omega

/-- Mixed-radix recovery by division. -/
theorem pair_div (a b B : Nat) (hB : 0 < B) (hb : b < B) : (a * B + b) / B = a := by
  rw [Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_mul_div_right _ _ hB, Nat.div_eq_of_lt hb, Nat.zero_add]

/-- Mixed-radix recovery by modulo. -/
theorem pair_mod (a b B : Nat) (hb : b < B) : (a * B + b) % B = b := by
  rw [Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_mul_mod_self_right, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hb]

/-- Mixed-radix injectivity. -/
theorem pair_inj (a b a' b' B : Nat) (hB : 0 < B) (hb : b < B) (hb' : b' < B)
    (h : a * B + b = a' * B + b') : a = a' ∧ b = b' := by
  have h1 := congrArg (fun x => x / B) h
  have h2 := congrArg (fun x => x % B) h
  simp only [pair_div a b B hB hb, pair_div a' b' B hB hb', pair_mod a b B hb,

  unfold clamp127
  split <;> try split
  all_goals omega

/-- The clamp is idempotent. -/

  clamp127_id _ (clamp127_bounds q).1 (clamp127_bounds q).2

  obtain ⟨e3, e4⟩ := pair_inj page h page' h' kvh hkvh hh hh' e1
